decisions.reason: The semi-hard wheel is closest to the core offer and uses existing milk supply and processes, so it most plausibly meets aspiration, though its absence from the website in 2020–2021 adds uncertainty.

The spicy cheese line may be pruned to fewer variants, but as a multi-model line it is more likely trimmed than dropped as a whole, even though dropping flagship B signals the cheese range fell short of aspiration.
Part of the 2018 cheese range whose flagship was already dropped and which has not been visible since 2019, so problemistic search points to moving its resources back to core organic dairy.

The washed-rind soft cheese is a niche item outside the firm's narrow core, with no visible evidence of success since 2019, so it likely falls below aspiration and its resources are better used in the established business.
